الحسن بن علي بن النصر الطوسي

shared_tail.surface: محمد بن عبد الرحمن ابن غزوان

notes: «حدثنا أبي» is a bare relation (the father of Abu al-Hasan): not identified
the three branches (Abu al-Hasan with his father; Ali ibn al-Abbas; al-Hasan ibn Ali) meet at «قالوا حدثنا محمد بن عبد الرحمن ابن غزوان»: that tail is written once and shared
the Companion is Abu Sa'id al-Khudri; the Prophet is not a link
